# **What is Create: SoulFire?**
Create: SoulFire is a Semi-Hardcore Souls-like RPG modpack with heavy Create mod influence that aims to completely change Minecraft. The pack enhances nearly every aspect of the game. New Visuals, New Terrain Generation that makes your world feel alive and everchanging along with you as you play. New dimensions to unlock. New ways to advance your technology with Create.  New ways to fight, battle, move and new enemies and foes to face with those moves. New ways to eat and survive. New ways to build. New ways to travel and explore with your friends. All with a story rich quest line that encourages learning about everything in the game. you'll have to survive difficult terrain and battle strong enemies to unlock the secrets of your world. The secret of SoulFire! But to get there you'll have to climb your way through a challenging progression system. Play with your friends, or travel on your own adventure.
Build a cozy village by the river, or build a massive factory, there are no limits.

You can expect this pack to feel challenging for crafting and general survival, but fair and rewarding. It encourages exploration and advancing your technology in an unfamiliar world that never limits your creativity.

# **Modpack Status: BETA**
This modpack is currently in very early development and is unstable, expect crashes and bugs. You can help track issues in the discord. It's recommended that if you find mod specific issues, that you report them to their respective mod author. You can find links to their mod pages below.

# **Development**
If you would like to help with playtesting the pack or to stay up to date with development, join the Discord below.
